about: What changed in ramen-agents, newest first, one entry per line. kind: key (a key worth adding), provider (a provider joined, left or changed terms), feature (something new or better), removed (something gone), your-step (something only you can do). step: the command you run, or empty. To see what is new since your copy: git fetch starter && git diff HEAD starter/fleet -- docs/updates.json (the added lines). Dates are when the change was made.

entries.line: The old local mode (Postgres on this Mac with sign-in codes) is gone: Peek on this Mac replaces it. An install still on it is told so at its next update.

The team's board can be Peek on this Mac (Leads, Tasks, Packages, Samples, Follow up), with sign-in off: new installs get it; an existing board moves only when you type yes after its counts, and every row is read back before the agents switch. sh scripts/peek.sh back returns to the dashboard's board.
Grok (xAI), Amazon Bedrock and Parallel are set aside: no free tier, or a card on file. MegaNova and Jina AI are marked usable: each answered free with no card.

add-key.sh and setup-check.py read common-data/providers.json: add-key.sh takes every provider that takes a key (sh scripts/add-key.sh --list), shows an unusable or set-aside one's reason and asks first, says when one is not free, and tests a key with its free read only.

Settings, Providers, All providers: every provider on one page, each with Add key, Test (a free read that cannot bill), Delete (the key moves to common-data/keys/deleted/) and a mark of your own. The By bot tab is gone: the members share one chain.

One list of 48 providers, common-data/providers.json: 16 the owner tested and found unusable and 12 the maintainers set aside, each with its reason and date, and 4 listed but not judged yet, with what their own pages say. None of them is suggested; each still takes a key if you choose.

sh scripts/update.sh --check shows what an update would change and changes nothing; --rollback goes back to the version before the last update; an edit you made to a persona is re-applied after the pull, and one that no longer applies stays in common-data/local/before-update/ and is named.

Two optional search keys, both free with no card: LangSearch (the first backup when the local search finds nothing) and Tavily (the CEO's special searches). Keyless search stays the default; neither is needed.
docs/updates.json (this file) and common-data/providers.json: what is new and every provider with its key, for you or your code agent to read.

The mailer settings ([send]), the chat partner and the developer tools (the file, shell and self-upgrade actions) are gone. An old config with these sections still loads and says once that each is ignored.
The supervisor no longer rolls back or changes the checkout by itself: updates come only from sh scripts/update.sh.
Unused dashboard code and two unused scripts (family_graph.py, sync-launchd.sh) are gone.
The Research Analyst is on the family card.
No local model by default: the family runs on free remote providers, and a local model runs only if you name one in fallback_provider.
Lead data is masked by default: a lead's email, phone and contact name reach remote models as stand-ins, and the Validator's review uses the same mask.
Gemini takes no lead data until you say yes, with Google's terms in front of you. Only if you have a Gemini key:
One model key is enough: bot check passes with one provider that answers, and a key that is rate limited at setup still counts.
Setup is clearer: install asks before using Homebrew, setup asks before loading launch agents, waits for the board and says plainly when no member started.
The write gate fails closed: a check that cannot load, run or give a verdict holds the write.
Automated reads say what they are, and a page that refuses a read is not used as evidence.
Mistral, Ollama Cloud and Speka left the default model chain: they need billing or are pay per token. A key file alone never adds them back.
Parallel left the default search path: its free credit needs a card on file.
Nothing installs or runs from the read-only copy on the main branch.
A keyed search's daily budget of 0 means no call.
docs/claude-team: a template for running ramen-agents with a team of Claude Code sessions.
The desktop control, the Tor reader and the blog-post action are gone from the engine.
The local board: Leads, Tasks and Packages in one file on your Mac, on the dashboard, with Import CSV and Export CSV.
Three commands from an empty Mac: install.sh, setup.sh (a few questions and one free key) and the dashboard's first-run page; add-key.sh and update.sh; your values in git-ignored files.
Notion is no longer used anywhere. To bring old leads over, export the Leads board from Notion as CSV, then on the dashboard: Boards, Leads, Import CSV. common-data/keys/notion.key can be deleted.
One free model key starts the family: Z.ai, Groq or OpenRouter. Gemini is a fourth, and it asks first.
The first release: the engine, five agents, the Validator, the fence in code, and the dashboard.
